verdict.rationale: Outlook exposes a documented REST API through Microsoft Graph, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents an OpenAPI, Swagger or equivalent spec download. The probe of common OpenAPI paths on learn.microsoft.com returned 404s. Mentions of OData query parameters describe API behaviour, not a downloadable spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
